behaviors.description: Entities contain validated appearance data without behavior or dependencies on other Entities. Their creation, updates and removal are accounted for. JSON material_surface appearances allow up to 32768 triangles so workshop worker, tools and specimens can be composed; other visual appearances keep the existing 8192-triangle bound. Numeric material updates retain their existing independent bound.
behaviors.selection: Available to declared callers throughout application lifetime, independently of which game event is active.

checks.expectation: Entity data remains independent; native resources are released before the owning Entity is removed.
checks.procedure: Review BaseEntity and EntitySystem for Entity dependencies; exercise accepted and rejected payloads and removal while native resources are still prepared. Check both cleanup and failure paths.

checks.expectation: A native immutable material skin preserves the JSON Entity/Get/Update representation and projects the same accepted vertices on every graphics backend. Updates retain shader checks, finite vertex validation and the material appearance budget.
checks.procedure: Run native_material_entity_keeps_immutable_skin_and_json_compatibility and numeric_material_skin_projects_identically_to_json. Compare the release mining mesh transport and CPU terrain-presentation timings separately from GPU FPS.

checks.expectation: Numeric render reads share immutable accepted Entity storage. Updates publish a replacement while existing readers retain their original data; JSON Get and owned snapshot compatibility, shader validation and removal errors remain unchanged.
checks.procedure: Run scene_cpu_shared_entity_reads_reuse_storage_and_preserve_old_snapshots, native_material_entity_keeps_immutable_skin_and_json_compatibility and registered scene-instance integration checks.
